_note: Institutional visits and experiences during YPDS Jakarta 2026 — from CSCD's official rundown document.

visits.name: Tugu Kunstkring Paleis
visits.description: Curated dinner experience at Jakarta's historic Kunstkring Paleis — an architectural gem blending heritage with contemporary diplomacy, introducing delegates to Jakarta's cultural atmosphere and diplomatic community.
highlights: Intimate networking with peers and mentors

visits.name: ASEAN Headquarters
visits.description: Strategic engagement with the Association of Southeast Asian Nations examining institutional framework, regional cooperation mechanisms, and cultural diplomacy's role in advancing integration. Sets the intellectual ground for the summit.
highlights: Multilateral institution coordinating Southeast Asian cooperation
Cultural diplomacy's role in ASEAN frameworks

visits.name: Ministry of Culture
visits.description: Exclusive engagement examining government cultural preservation initiatives, artistic development support, and international cultural diplomacy frameworks, exploring policy linkages between culture and diplomatic objectives.
highlights: Indonesian agency for cultural preservation & artistic development
Policy frameworks linking culture to diplomatic objectives

visits.name: Embassy of Pakistan
visits.description: Diplomatic engagement with Pakistani embassy officials examining bilateral cultural cooperation, public diplomacy practice, and South-South cultural exchanges. Subject to diplomatic confirmation.

visits.name: Gudskul
visits.description: Immersive experience at Gudskul, an innovative creative and research institute, combining institutional engagement with continued policy discussions. Examines how independent cultural institutions contribute to public diplomacy, community engagement, and artistic innovation.
